digest.component_or_area: Cloud rate-limit sweep / Jira adapters transport layer
propositions: The rate-limit sweep's file list is hardcoded rather than derived, risking drift when classified mutating names are moved or renamed outside swept modules.
Current measurement finds exactly two unswept definitions colliding with classified mutating names: backend.py::set_relationship and backend.py::add_comment, both pure self.transport delegations.

An anti-drift assertion must scan all unswept Jira adapter modules (including acli_subprocess.py and jira_fields.py) and accept only pure same-name transport delegations with arguments forwarded unchanged.
The swept transport file list must be an explicit named constant to make the sweep's declared subject reviewable and preserve the transport-layer scope, rejecting package-wide globbing.
The guard must reject any deviation from pure delegation: guards, retries, logging, argument transforms, dropped/reordered args, non-transport targets, or renamed methods.
